thread:
Maya: Kicking off Synapse POC perf run with the prospect. They want 10k sustained qps for embeddings + chat mix, with microburst tolerance. Can we confirm run plan and security pre-reqs? :eyes:
Sam: Love it. Proposed plan: 3 phases — smoke (1k qps), steady-state (10k qps Poisson), and stress (15k short bursts). Capture p50/p90/p95/p99 + tail (99.9) and tokens/sec. Warmups 15m each.
Priya: For the mixed workload we need explicit payload mix. Recommend: 60% chat gen (avg prompt 120 tokens, gen 200 tokens), 40% embeddings (avg 768 dim). Also include 5% long-chat (gen 1k tokens) to exercise kv cache.
Elena: Confirming payload mix from customer side: 55/45 chat/embeddings, long-chat 3% not 5%. Also they want multi-region failover check.
Sam: Ok adjust to 55/45 and long-chat 3%. Multi-region: primary us-west, failover eu-west. We'll do a controlled failover in phase 2 (at 50% steady).
Maya: Ops & pricing asks from customer: will POC traffic be billed as on-demand or on reserved? Need estimate for 72h run cost.
Priya: For hosted API: token-based on-demand. For Dedicated: pro-rated reserved + minimal overage. I can draft a cost model. Quick calc: expected tokens ~ 2.6B over 72h at their mix — rough number.
Jorge: Security blockers: they asked for KMS/HSM integration, and encrypted-at-rest proofs + SOC2 summary. I can attach a short answers doc but need the security questionnaire from their legal team (we have 48h SLA to respond).
Maya: I'll request the questionnaire now. @Elena can you forward?
Elena: Sent the vendor sec questionnaire to maya@synapse earlier, just re-sent to the thread.
OpsBot: Deploy job started: perf-run/synapse/poc-1765554322 at 2024-10-03T09:12:00Z. Tracker: https://ops/internal/runs/1765554322
Priya: Runbook snippet for load generator (k6 Poisson):
```
k6 run --vus 5000 --duration 30m --out influxdb=http://influx:8086 script_poisson.js
// script_poisson.js will sample latencies and payload mix per iteration
```
Sam: We'll collect metrics via Prometheus/Grafana and export raw traces for p99 analysis. Please ensure GPU metrics (util, mem, temp) are included.
Priya: Note on model variants: we'll test 1) fp16 full, 2) int8 quantized. Expect ~1.6x throughput on int8 but monitor quality. We'll keep a small eval set to check regressions during runs.
Jorge: Regarding KMS: for hosted we can use our KMS proxy; for Dedicated/Private they can bring keys via customer-managed KMS. Document attached in the thread (sec-summary.pdf).
Maya: Timeline: smoke tomorrow 09:30 PT, steady + failover tomorrow 13:00 PT, stress window 16:00 PT. Can everyone confirm availability?
Priya: Confirmed for eng, will be on-call during runs.
Sam: I'll run the cost calc and post numbers before steady phase.
Elena: Customer side: infra team will be available for failover step, legal will send Q by EOD. Thanks.
Maya: Final checklist before smoke:
- test payload templates (Sam)
- k6 scripts validated (Priya)
- cost estimate (Sam)
- sec questionnaire ack + SOC2 summary (Jorge)
- run dashboard + alerts (Ops)

Sam: Quick example curl for sanity check (small sample):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC" -d '{"model":"rwd-4","prompt":"Hello world","max_tokens":20}'
```
Maya: Thanks team — will sync 15m before smoke. :thumbsup:
